text:
Ava: Quick sync — finalizing rebuttal one-pagers for the Q2 launch vs managed endpoints and infra vendors. Need crisp responses for: latency, cost, private deployments, model pinning, rollouts. Drafts here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/rebuttals (draft folder)
Diego: On it. Sales wants 3 TL;DR lines per objection + 1 example soundbite each.
Priya: Field note — common ask: 'why not just use ProviderX managed endpoints?' Main pain is unpredictable tail latency and multi-tenant bursts. Suggested quick response: 'Predictable SLOs + Dedicated capacity = consistent UX during bursts.'
Sam: Add routing/fallback as a differentiation: 'Automatic fallback to compatible model variants during capacity spikes keeps SLAs intact.'
Marta: :thumbsup: Also include a simple cost math snippet for sales. Example line: 'Workload-aware batching + KV caching reduces per-token cost from ~$0.02 to ~$0.005 on typical convo patterns.'
Annabel: Can we make a webinar-focused 1-pager listing the benchmarks buyers care about? e.g., p95 latency, tokens/sec, and $/million tokens.
Diego: @Sam can you give a 1-line on quantization vs quality we can paste?
Sam: Sure: '4-bit quantization is a good cost/throughput sweet spot for many workloads; we ship vetted quant profiles tied to eval suites so quality regressions are flagged automatically.'
Ava: Okay — action items: @Priya draft the 'Why not managed endpoints' rebuttal (3 lines + 1 demo snippet). @Diego assemble TL;DRs and soundbites. @Marta build the landing copy and a CSV for inbound routing. @Sam provide the 2-line technical blurbs on rollouts and quant. I'll stitch and final review.
Priya: I'll drop my draft in #marketing-drafts by EOD.
Diego: Draft soundbite try: 'Owning serving, not just models — predictable latency and unit cost accelerate product velocity.'
Annabel: :eyes: love that. For AE cheat sheet — format each row as: objection -> rebuttal -> proof (benchmark link).
Marta: I'll create a CSV: columns = [objection,rebuttal,proof_link,likelihood]. That will power routing for inbound leads and AE playbooks.
Ava: Also add a security/compliance micro-rebuttal for Private deployments (KMS/HSM, VPC, audit logs).
Sam: Tiny pasteable snippet for security:
```
Objection: 'We can't use hosted APIs for sensitive data.'
Rebuttal: 'Private deployment option with customer-managed VPC, KMS integrations, HSM support, and audit logs; Dedicated can run critical workloads with SLA backing.'
```
Priya: Perfect. For webinar demos, let's include a simple p95 comparison: Dedicated vs Managed under burst load. @Marta can you get ops screenshots?
Marta: I'll coordinate. Ops contact is @Ethan-ops.
Ethan-ops: I can run a synthetic load tonight. What model + sequence length should I use?
Priya: Llama2-70B, sequence ~512 tokens, pattern: 50 rps steady -> 500 rps spike for 60s.
Ethan-ops: Got it. I'll upload screenshots to /marketing/assets/bench/ by tomorrow morning.
Diego: Timeline check — we need final 1-pagers by Friday to prep webinar slides. Who's blocked?
Ava: No blockers yet. If anyone gets stuck, ping me or drop in #marketing-drafts.
Annabel: For the AE cheat-sheet, can we add 1 quick line of proof per rebuttal e.g., 'p95 80ms vs 420ms under spike — link to run'? That helps close faster.
Marta: Will do. I'll also add a column with a single-sentence "how to demo" step for each rebuttal.
Diego: Nice. One last thought — include a short 'battlecard elevator' paragraph (30–40 words) that AEs can memorize for trade shows.
Ava: Good call. I'll draft 3 variants and share in the draft channel.
Priya: Dropping a draft in 30 mins.
Ethan-ops: Load run scheduled at 10pm PT.
Marta: Thanks all — sounds like we're on track. :rocket:
